text: dsh-policy-waiver-proof 是面向 DSH 的离线策略豁免核验插件，通过注册两个工具，检查显式 JSON 清单中的临时豁免使用记录是否符合主体、版本、作用域、动作白名单、有效期、次数上限和补偿控制要求。它可以先查看清单中的哈希与计数，再核验全部使用和控制证据，并将脱敏、内容寻址的报告写入工作区指定目录。适合需要审阅临时策略例外是否按批准范围使用的 DSH 工作流。运行核验需要 Node.js 22 或更新版本；代码没有配置 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-policy-waiver-proof is an offline DSH plugin for checking temporary waivers against approved scope, actions, dates, use limits, and control evidence. Its tools inspect manifest hashes and counts or verify records and write a redacted report to a workspace directory. Requires Node.js 22 or newer.

dsh-policy-waiver-proof 的功能「豁免范围核验」：检查动作、主体、范围、版本、时间、次数及控制证据，返回 contained 或 breached。通过 DSH 工具提交清单路径和报告目录触发。
dsh-policy-waiver-proof 的功能「清单摘要检查」：读取传入的 JSON 清单并返回证明编号哈希、目标版本哈希、使用计数和所需控制计数，不执行豁免授权。通过 DSH 检查工具传入 manifestJson 触发。

dsh-policy-waiver-proof README · DSH Policy Waiver Proof：**Maintainer / Author：He Fangsheng (贺方升 / 贺去病; also known as Dosen) · [hequbing.com](https://www.hequbing.com)**

An offline, deterministic evidence layer for temporary policy exceptions in DeepSeek Harness. It proves whether recorded uses stayed within an approved subject, revision, scope, action allowlist, time window, use limit, and compensating controls. It **does not grant** a waiver, change policy, approve a tool call, or execute an external command.

This is complementary to:

dsh-policy-waiver-proof README · DSH Policy Waiver Proof：- `dsh-tool-policy`, which evaluates pre-execution policy rules.
- `dsh-policy-drift-proof`, which detects policy/configuration drift.
- `dsh-decision-effect-proof`, which reconciles a decision with a resulting effect.

dsh-policy-waiver-proof README · DSH Policy Waiver Proof：Policy Waiver Proof instead verifies the bounded lifecycle of an already-issued temporary exception, including revocation or closure. Denied attempts are disclosed but do not consume the approved use limit. Reports contain only hashes, counts, booleans, public bounded IDs transformed to hashes, and machine-readable verdicts; raw business bodies and secret-shaped material are rejected.

dsh-policy-waiver-proof README · Install and compose：```bash
dsh plugin add github:dongsheng123132/dsh-policy-waiver-proof#COMMIT
```

The DSH bundle publishes two tools from one headless core:

- `dsh_policy_waiver_inspect`
- `dsh_policy_waiver_verify`

The independent MCP stdio server publishes `policy_waiver_inspect` and `policy_waiver_verify`. The CLI accepts `inspect` or `verify` followed by an explicit JSON manifest path.

dsh-policy-waiver-proof README · Manifest and verdict：See [`examples/contained.json`](examples/contained.json). Evidence is explicit and hash-addressed. Applied uses must be contiguous, occur before evaluation and within the waiver window, match all bindings, remain below `maxUses`, precede revocation/closure, and have fresh effective compensating controls. Any violation produces `breached`; missing or stale evidence is never silently inferred.

dsh-policy-waiver-proof README · Manifest and verdict：The DSH verify tool reads only a workspace-relative non-symlink manifest and writes only to an explicit workspace-relative `artifactDir`. Its deterministic report filename is the SHA-256 of canonical report bytes, created exclusively and verified by read-back.

dsh-policy-waiver-proof README · Verify locally：```bash
npm test
npm run check
npm run smoke:plugin
npm run smoke:mcp

Node.js 22 or newer is required. No runtime dependency or network access is used by the verifier.

dsh-policy-waiver-proof README · DSH 临时策略豁免证据：作者 / 维护者：He Fangsheng (贺方升 / 贺去病; also known as Dosen)· [hequbing.com](https://www.hequbing.com)

这是 DeepSeek Harness 的离线、确定性证据层，用来核验已经签发的临时策略例外是否严格限定在指定主体、目标版本、作用域、动作白名单、有效期、使用次数和补偿控制内。

它不签发豁免、不修改策略、不批准工具调用，也不执行外部命令。它与执行前规则引擎 `dsh-tool-policy`、策略漂移证明 `dsh-policy-drift-proof`、决策—效果对账 `dsh-decision-effect-proof` 互补，专门回答“这份临时例外有没有被越界使用”。

输入只接受显式 JSON 清单；原始业务正文、凭据和秘密形态字段会被拒绝。输出只保留哈希、计数、布尔检查和机器可读的 `contained` / `breached` 判决。DSH 写盘工具只读取工作区内非符号链接文件，只写入显式 `artifactDir`，并对内容寻址报告执行独占创建和回读校验。
